newsitem.title: USA: Air Liquide to raise U.S. argon, CO2 prices.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide to raise U.S. argon, CO2 prices.

text.p: Air Liquide America Corp said Monday it will be raising prices for liquid argon by an average of $0.15 per hundred standard cubic feet, effective October 1.
Prices for carbon dioxide will also be increased $5.00 per ton, the Air Liquide Group subsidiary said.
It said the increases reflect the impact of rising energy prices on transportation and production costs.
The company also said price discounts for liquid oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen will be eliminated or reduced as conditions permit.

"The increase for both argon and carbon dioxide not only reflects higher costs, but also incorporates the recognized value of continuous supply which Air Liquide has been able to provide to its customers during recent industry-wide shortages," stated Edgardo Martinez, Vice President, Merchant Activities. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
